quest.title: Lantern of the Wayfarer
quest.description: While most people from Liyue are enjoying the Lantern Rite, guard-for-hire Huangshan is currently in a bit of a fix...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to deliver this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: You're a traveler, I'll wager. You're quite the lucky one, to have come to Liyue just as the Lantern Rite is beginning. I, on the other hand, don't have much time for celebration...

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: We natives of Liyue have a tradition of releasing Xiao Lanterns during the Lantern Rite. Every year, the amount of lantern-making materials making the rounds through the trade routes is massive.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: And it might just be my imagination, but it feels like this year's got even more cargo than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: It's all a little too much for me right now, and what's more, that merchant keeps rushing me, without any consideration for the road conditions here in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: I'm of a mind to ask someone for help, but haven't been able to find anyone suitable. You up for an escort job?

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: Great! I like straightforward people. If only the person we were escorting was more like you...

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: His name is Fran, uh... Francis. Ugh, I don't have a head for foreign names.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: If you're helping out, meet me at the place where the stores are being kept.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: I've marked that spot on your map. I'll be heading there first. Let's meet up in a bit.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: That's right. What was his name again... Fran... Francis? Ugh, foreign names are so hard to pronounce.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: I don't know what he wants with such a large batch of goods either, but... Well, so long as he's paying.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: Don't worry, you'll get your fair share once the work's done.

talks.objective: Talk to Huangshan at the goods storage location

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Well, this is where we store the goods. I do realize that I'm troubling you to help out, so you just need to escort this one Transport Balloon.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: But let me just remind you, the cargo it carries is entirely made of fragile materials used in Xiao Lantern construction.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: It won't do if they get damaged or burned, so you have to be careful while you're out there on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Best be on your guard, monsters and Treasure Hoarders pass this way from time to time, too.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Well, I'll leave this run to you. Just make sure the goods get to Francis safe and sound, and we'll meet afterwards on the bridge southwest of Chihu Rock.

talks.objective: Escort the transport balloon to Francis

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: These are... the goods I ordered. My word, they're finally here.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: From your style of dress, friend, you must also not be a Liyue local. Am I right in saying so?

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Ah, friend, I do not know if you have had the privilege of trying Liyue's delicacies, but they are lovely. Believe me, they are absolutely worth a try!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Alright, now that my cargo has arrived, I can return to eating in peace.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to look for Huangshan
Give the finished Xiao Lantern to Huangshan

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Oh, this Xiao Lantern's pretty good. Thanks! Let me see, what should I write...

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Ah, I don't think I can come up with anything good... Let's just go with "may everything go well," I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: As long as all things go as I expect them to, I'll be thankful to Rex Lapis already.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Oh yes, here's your compensation. Thanks so much for your help, and for that Xiao Lantern you gave me.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: I've been in contact with Francis. He's received that batch of goods — thanks a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When did you do that?

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Haha, oh, not to worry. Guards for hire like myself are quicker on our feet than most, and when it comes to handovers... We're pretty quick there, too.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: It's thanks to your help that this run went smoothly. And just so you know, I'm a believer in reasonable pay for all. So give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not taking a break for the Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: In our line of business, you never know when there'll be work. Can't even be home for the Lantern Rite... But then again, it can't be helped.

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: If you're traveling the world, you should go to Liyue to experience the Rite — everyone should be releasing Xiao Lanterns at this time.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: Oh, I do work outside the city year in and year out. Never quite had the time to release a Xiao Lantern.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: If I had a ready-made one, it sure would be nice to release one for good luck, but I haven't the time to put a lantern together myself.

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: I'm missing out on that festive cheer for sure, but I guess it doesn't matter that much...

choices.text: Why don't I make you one?

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: Huh? You'll get one for me? You're... a pretty nice person, aren't you?

choices.text: Have you released a Xiao Lantern yet?

response.speaker: Huangshan
response.text: Not yet. Traveling guards like us don't have time for that sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Where's that cargo... My stomach's growling already...

dialogues.speaker: Huangshan
dialogues.text: Are you really going to make me a Xiao Lantern?
